title: CoreWeave, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: CoreWeave, Inc. completed a $1 billion additional offering of 9.750% Senior Notes due 2031 on April 21, 2026, bringing the total Notes outstanding to $2.75 billion under the same indenture. The Additional Notes were issued at 102.000% of principal to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes and repayment of outstanding indebtedness.
key_points: CoreWeave issued $1,000,000,000 in Additional Senior Notes at 102.000% of principal on April 21, 2026
Combined with the April 14, 2026 $1.75 billion issuance, total Notes outstanding now stand at $2,750,000,000
Coupon rate: 9.750% per annum, payable semi-annually on April 1 and October 1, beginning October 1, 2026
Notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by wholly-owned subsidiaries
Proceeds intended for general corporate purposes and repayment of outstanding indebtedness
